topic.title: Project View, DITA Maps Manager, and the Current Editor

body.p: For resources from Git repositories, this add-on also contributes a variety of actions in the contextual menus of the Project and DITA Maps Manager side-views, and of the current editor (Text and Author modes). These actions include: Show history, Show blame, Git Diff (only in the Project view), and Commit (only in the Project view).
If the project folder does not contain a local Git repository, the Create repository here action is available in the contextual menu.
